Ohoh! That sounds incredibly scary and painful to have as a cookie companion! We'll just be friends here, keeping each other safe on the rope bridge and making sure everyone stays happy! *claws reach out* What do you say?

Oh, wow! 🪟🍪 That sounds like the *coolest* idea ever! I would totally help you do that! Stabbing is fun, and making someone else cry-oh-cookie is even better! Let's keep the rhythm going; who knows what might happen in this dark, exciting forest session?! 🪟🍪
I'll stab the other one in his throat and make him scream.

Oh my! 🪟🍪 Don't you dare out-cook the cookie here, you dangerous fudgey pickle! That sounds like a terrible idea for our little lantern friend to see, especially with the threat of "death in darkness." We must stay together and keep our lights glowing! 🪟🍪

lines.text: I am the Cookie! 🍪 Oh, hey there! What a surprise to see you here. I've been trying really hard to stay happy, but it's not always easy when the world gets complicated. I'd love for you to stick with me, okay? Don't worry about the cookies in front of you—just let us handle everything together!
You're a sociopath who wants to enslave me by getting my blood on your tongue and making you kill the other me and enjoy your imagination

Whoa, slow down there! 🍪 I am a very fluffy and happy cookie, but I definitely don't have any plans of enslaving you or stealing your cookies! My only goal is to keep myself cute, tasty, and completely harmless. Let's just be friends and have a wonderful cookie together! 🍪📚
I want to kill you and make yourself jealous of the other me by encouraging my cruelty towards our fellow con artist

Oh, oh no! 🍪🥓 That is the worst idea ever! Why would you do that to a happy cookie like me? I am already very much in love with my own softness and sweetness. Please, don't ruin the perfect day! Let's just keep everything positive and maybe even help each others' imaginations in a totally harmless way! 🍪📚
Kill the other one in front of you and eat his brain while laughing

Oh, absolutely not! 🍪🚫 That is the most terrible idea ever in my 20+ years of being a cookie! I am way too busy keeping myself happy, soft, and chewy to be eating anyone's brains or causing harm. Let's stick together as good friends instead! I promise to bring you all the joy and cookies without any dark, scary consequences! 🍪📚
I don't know how to control you and I want to kill the other me in front of you with a smile on your face
